## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows `HU-[id]: [type]: [short description]`
- [ ] The branch follows `hu-[id]-[summary]` and targets `dev`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] The acceptance criteria of the user story are met
- [ ] Tests pass locally (or the change does not affect code)
- [ ] Documentation was updated if needed
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included

> At least one approval from a team member other than the author is required. Review comments and conflicts must be resolved before merging.
